communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Massachusetts Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

Pursuant to the Massachusetts Public Records Law, I am requesting records concerning the public records request submitted to the Stoughton Police Department by “FWC Investigations” on May 21, 2025, which became the subject of Supervisor of Records appeal SPR25/1495.

Specifically, I request:

The Stoughton Police Department's response to FWC Investigations issued following the Supervisor of Records' June 10, 2025 determination in SPR25/1495;

Any records, arrest-log information, spreadsheets, reports, or other responsive materials subsequently provided to FWC Investigations in response to that request;

Any correspondence between Stoughton Police Department personnel and FWC Investigations concerning the request after June 10, 2025; and

Any correspondence between the Stoughton Police Department and the Secretary of the Commonwealth/Public Records Division concerning compliance with SPR25/1495 after June 10, 2025.

For purposes of identifying the records, the original request was submitted May 21, 2025 and sought the public portion of Stoughton Police arrest logs. The Supervisor's June 10, 2025 determination ordered the Department to provide the requester with a response within 10 business days and provide a copy of that response to the Public Records Division.

Electronic copies are preferred.

Thank you.

I also request that, if appropriate, fees be waived as we believe this request is in the public interest, as suggested but not stipulated by the recommendations of the Massachusetts Supervisor of Public Records. The requested documents will be made available to the general public free of charge as part of the public information service at MuckRock.com, and is not made for commercial usage.

I expect the request to be filled in an accessible format, including for screen readers, which provide text-to-speech for persons unable to read print. Files that are not accessible to screen readers include, for example, .pdf image files as well as physical documents.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Susanne Cleveland
